text:
The text exhibits strong narrative and descriptive elements, focusing on sensory details (laughter, flushed faces, wind) and emotional resonance (joy, beauty in the everyday). It uses figurative language and paints a vivid scene rather than presenting factual information, arguments, or technical instructions. These characteristics are hallmarks of creative writing, specifically descriptive prose or literary fiction.

Regarding the priority question embedded in the content: The primary material of a traditional candle is wax (such as paraffin, beeswax, or soy wax), which serves as the fuel, along with a wick (typically cotton) that draws the fuel up to the flame.

Genre: Descriptive Prose / Literary Fiction
